title: Drag window (not Task Manager task) to virtual desktop to move it to that virtual desktop
line: Dragging a window by its titlebar onto a desktop in the Pager now moves the window to that desktop.
explanation: While a window is being moved, KWin keeps the pointer to itself, so the panel and its Pager never see the window arriving and dropping it there does nothing; the window just ends up under the panel. KWin now turns the move into a drag-and-drop offer (mime application/x-kde-window-uuid carrying the window's id) while the pointer is over a panel, and goes back to a normal move when the pointer leaves it. The Pager accepts that drop and sends the window to the desktop (or activity) under the pointer, and KWin then puts the window back where it was before the move; the Task Manager ignores the offer so crossing it doesn't activate tasks.

commits.message:
input: offer windows moved over a panel as a drag

Dragging a window by its titlebar onto the pager did nothing, since the
panel never saw the move. Now the window is offered to panels as a drag
and keeps its old position if the drop sends it to another desktop.

BUG: 488419

applets/pager: send windows dropped by their titlebar to that desktop

KWin offers a window moved over a panel as a drag carrying its id. The
pager now sends that window to the desktop it's dropped on, while the
task manager ignores it so crossing tasks doesn't activate them.

BUG: 488419

media.caption: Master: Konsole dragged by its titlebar onto the Pager's desktop 2 and released; it stays on the current desktop, stuck under the panel, and desktop 2 is empty
With the fix: same drag; the window leaves the current desktop, and clicking desktop 2 shows it there at its original position
Master right after the drop: the window sits under the panel on the same desktop
With the fix: the window on desktop 2, where it was before the drag
